# pairs with

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:pairsWith`](gmeow-pairsWith.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/pairsWith>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

Links the two halves of a flat-first/reify-on-demand pair — the flat shortcut and the reified relator that carries the same relationship when period, role, confidence, or standpoint must be first-class ([`gmeow:hasGoal`](gmeow-hasGoal.md) ↔ [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md); [`gmeow:hasLicense`](gmeow-hasLicense.md) ↔ [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md); [`gmeow:narrates`](gmeow-narrates.md) ↔ [`gmeow:NarrationUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NarrationUsage.md)). Symmetric by doctrine, asserted in one direction (flat → reified) and read both ways by tooling; an AnnotationProperty so the pairing is machine-usable documentation (gmeow describe renders the promotion path from it), never a logical bridge ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12): no axiom makes the flat form entail the relator).

## Structure

**Property shape:** annotation property

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:pairsWith`](gmeow-pairsWith.md) when the definition matches the source fact. Prefer a narrower GMEOW term when one exists, and keep projection concerns in the mapping layer.
